description: This file defines a PHP class 'JobTitleSearchFilterParams' used for filtering and sorting job title search results within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties and methods specific to job title search filters.

classes.name: JobTitleSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object used for specifying search filters related to job titles, including sorting and activation status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of JobTitleSearchFilterParams and sets default sort field to 'jt.jobTitleName'.

methods.name: getActiveOnly
methods.description: Returns whether the filter is restricted to active job titles.

methods.name: setActiveOnly
methods.description: Sets whether the filter should include only active job titles.
